title: Run migration on workspace stores
description:
Plan Context: Replace per-store auto-increment numeric `id` on knowledge insights with UUID v4 strings, eliminating cross-store ID collisions and enabling stable IDs across moves/copies.

Description: Execute the migration script against the actual workspace stores to convert all 10 knowledge store files to v2 format, then verify migration correctness and run the full test suite.

Scope:
- `ledger-storage/store/.knowledge/*.json` (7 files)
- `nexus-ledger-storage/store/.knowledge/*.json` (3 files)

Deliverables:
- All 10 knowledge store files migrated to v2 format.
- Full MCP server test suite passes against migrated data.

Estimated Complexity: Low

Notes: Depends on WP-001 (script exists) and WP-007 (tests updated, which transitively depends on WP-002/WP-005/WP-006 code changes). Both stores should be committed to Git before running the migration.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: `--dry-run` completes without errors and reports all 10 files.
After migration, every knowledge store file has `"version": "2.0.0"`, no `next_id` field, and all insight `id` values are valid UUID v4 strings.
The full MCP server test suite (`npm test` in `mcp-server/`) passes with no regressions.
Re-running the migration script produces no changes (idempotent).

summary: All 10 knowledge store files already at v2.0.0 — migration was pre-applied before QA stage.
AC1 PASS: --dry-run completed without errors, reported all 10 files (7 ledger-storage + 3 nexus-ledger-storage).
AC2 PASS: All 10 files confirmed version=2.0.0, no next_id field, 159 insights all carry valid UUID v4 IDs.
AC3 PASS: Full MCP server test suite — 4031 tests across 146 files, all pass, no regressions.
AC4 PASS: Re-running migration with no flags produced 0 changes — 10 files skipped (already v2.0.0), confirming idempotency.

comments.note: All 10 files were pre-migrated to v2 before this QA stage executed — the migration was already complete. UUID v4 validation on all 159 insights across both stores confirmed correct format. No issues found.

summary: WP-008 is a purely operational work package — no new code written, existing migration script executed against workspace stores.
Independent verification confirmed: 159 insights across 10 files (7 ledger-storage + 3 nexus-ledger-storage) all at version 2.0.0, valid UUID v4 IDs, zero next_id residue.
Migration script quality review PASS: atomic write via .tmp+renameSync, correct idempotency guard, proper store-discovery priority chain, stdlib-only, cross-platform compliant.
superseded_by cross-file drop behavior is correct — dangling cross-file references would be invalid anyway; the code handles this cleanly.
No blocking issues. QA's full 4031/4031 test-suite result and all 4 acceptance criteria confirmed met.

comments.note: No observations — migration script is clean, well-structured, and idempotent. Atomic write pattern and correct store-discovery chain are solid choices for a one-time operational script.

[documentation-forward] scripts/migrate-knowledge-uuids.js: the superseded_by cross-file drop behavior (lines ~140-145) could benefit from a one-line comment explaining *why* dropping is safe — cross-file superseded_by references are structurally invalid since each knowledge file is a self-contained scope unit. The current comment only says 'drop if the source ID is not in this file' without explaining the rationale.

notes: All 4 acceptance criteria met. 10 knowledge store files (7 ledger-storage + 3 nexus-ledger-storage) confirmed at v2.0.0 with UUID v4 IDs. Full test suite: 4031/4031 passed. Migration is idempotent. Ready for code-review stage.

All 4 acceptance criteria met and independently verified by Reviewer. 159 insights across 10 files confirmed at v2.0.0 with valid UUID v4 IDs. Migration script is clean and idempotent. One low-priority documentation-forward comment recorded on superseded_by cross-file drop rationale. Ready for documentation stage.
